title: v5.103.73 shipped: Fan recheck runs in bedrooms and media rooms by day
summary: Fan recheck runs in bedrooms and media rooms by day
why: JAYA-FAN-STILL-PHANTOM-1 was parked with a revival trigger that fired on 10-12: Jaya Bedroom held occupied for two hours by day by its ESP32 radar alone, fan on, Jaya away, and no recheck ran because the all-day high_still_risk veto refused every bedroom (54 vetoes since the afternoon restart). The post-Rev2 audit showed the restore loop is fixed (9/9 vacates kept the fan off), so admitting bedrooms is now worth it. Operator ruled: no blanket refusal outside sleep; refuse only when BLE has the person in the room, including the room's configured scanner areas. Plan review caught media-room sleep exposure; review B caught a mid-pause sleep-edge leaving a fan off all night; review C closed five test gaps. Full name-diff clean.
implications: Shipped JAYA-FAN-STILL-PHANTOM-1 at v5.103.73; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.73.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Organic: first daytime fan-on radar-sole hold with Jaya away must produce a fan_recheck_outcome row; ESP32 LD2410 family/clear-time measurement is a separate card
